run_compute_score: run the SQuAD evaluation script with a dataset file and prediction file via CLI
test_f1_score: test the f1_score function that computes F1 between a prediction and ground truth string
test_exact_match_score: test the exact_match_score function that checks if normalized prediction equals normalized ground truth
test_normalize_answer: test the normalize_answer function that lowercases, removes punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
test_compute_score: test the compute_score function that computes exact_match and f1 metrics over a SQuAD dataset and predictions
